notes: DECISION: ForceManager's app icon is a black tile with a green dot and two white dots. A black tile can't be seen on the dark theme, so the tile is left out: dark mode shows the dots as the brand has them (green, white), light mode shows the white dots black. The app is now listed as Sage Sales Management with the same mark.
